summary: Pinterest filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, reporting entry into an amended and restated five-year $700 million revolving credit facility, replacing its prior $500 million facility from October 2022. JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. serves as administrative agent. Pricing is adjusted term SOFR plus 1.25% or base rate plus 0.25%, with a 0.10% commitment fee and $75 million letter-of-credit sublimit. An accordion permits up to the greater of $1,000 million and 75% of consolidated EBITDA. A maximum net leverage covenant applies, with certain restrictions falling away during an investment-grade period.
